offline_test: Hash-bound copy into isolated directory and exact removal of only the newly created matching candidate; original bytes remain unchanged
preconditions: Preserve current source/reader bytes, modes, ACL and hashes
Bind reviewed map content and protected candidate path
Reject symlink, hardlink, unexpected owner or hash drift
preferred_strategy: Version reviewed mapping and make a verified immutable runtime copy; retain current file until a separately approved caller cutover
rollback: Before cutover discard only own matching candidate; after any future cutover restore backed-up caller only under reviewed authority model, otherwise keep caller stopped. Never delete existing evidence or restore an unsafe privileged dependency automatically.
